suggestions.animatediff_context_error: AnimateDiff Context Error: Context length is invalid or out of range. Adjust the context_length parameter.
suggestions.animatediff_frame_mismatch: AnimateDiff Frame Mismatch: Frame count doesn't match expectations. Ensure consistent frame count throughout the workflow.
suggestions.animatediff_model_not_found: AnimateDiff Model Not Found: The AnimateDiff motion model file could not be found. Check models/animatediff/ directory.
suggestions.animatediff_oom: AnimateDiff Out of Memory: Out of memory during animation generation. Reduce frame count, resolution, or batch size.
suggestions.assertion: Assertion Failed: {0}. This usually indicates the input data doesn't meet the node's expectations. Check the upstream node's output format.
suggestions.attribute_error: Attribute Error: Type '{0}' has no attribute '{1}'. This might be due to version mismatch in custom nodes or incorrect model format.
suggestions.autograd: A PyTorch Autograd error occurred. If you are training, check your loss function. If inference, this shouldn't happen.
suggestions.checkpoint_corrupted: Corrupted Checkpoint: Model checkpoint file is corrupted or invalid. Try re-downloading the checkpoint.
suggestions.clip_encoding_error: CLIP Text Encoding Failed: CLIP failed to encode the text prompt. Check for special characters or try simplifying the prompt.
suggestions.controlnet_channel_mismatch: ControlNet Channel Mismatch: The control image channel count doesn't match expectations. Ensure correct image format (RGB/Grayscale).
suggestions.controlnet_device_mismatch: ControlNet Device Mismatch: ControlNet model is on a different device than the base model. Ensure all models are on the same device (GPU/CPU).
suggestions.controlnet_invalid_strength: Invalid ControlNet Strength: The control strength value must be between 0 and 1. Adjust the strength parameter.
suggestions.controlnet_missing_preprocessor: Missing ControlNet Preprocessor: Required preprocessor not installed. Install the missing preprocessor via ComfyUI-Manager.
suggestions.controlnet_model_not_found: ControlNet Model Not Found: The specified ControlNet model could not be found. Check if the model file exists in models/controlnet/ directory.
suggestions.controlnet_preprocessor_failed: ControlNet Preprocessor Failed: The preprocessor execution failed. Verify the preprocessor is correctly installed and the input image is valid.
suggestions.controlnet_size_mismatch: ControlNet Size Mismatch: The control image dimensions don't match the base image. Ensure both images have the same resolution.
suggestions.controlnet_unsupported_model: Unsupported ControlNet Model: This ControlNet model type is not supported. Try using a different model or updating your ControlNet nodes.
suggestions.cudnn_error: CUDNN Execution Failed: Your GPU or Driver might have issues with specific operations. Try running ComfyUI with '--force-fp32' or update your NVIDIA drivers.
suggestions.device_type: Device/Type Error: Input is {0} but Weights are {1}. Ensure everything is on the same device (GPU/CPU) and same precision.
suggestions.dimension_mismatch: Dimension Mismatch: Tensor {0} (size {1}) doesn't match Tensor {2} (size {3}) at dim {4}. Check your latent dimensions or image sizes. Are you mixing different resolutions?
suggestions.facerestore_detection_failed: Face Detection Failed: No faces detected in the input image. Ensure the image contains visible faces.
suggestions.facerestore_model_not_found: Face Restoration Model Not Found: CodeFormer or GFPGAN model not found. Install via ComfyUI-Manager or check models/facerestore/.
suggestions.facerestore_oom: Face Restoration Out of Memory: Out of memory during face restoration. Reduce image resolution or batch size.
suggestions.file_not_found: File Not Found: '{0}'. Please verify the path is correct and check if the model or LoRA has been downloaded.
suggestions.image_format_unsupported: Unsupported Image Format: The image file format is not supported. Use common formats like PNG, JPG, or WEBP.
suggestions.invalid_prompt: Invalid Prompt Format: The workflow JSON sent to ComfyUI is malformed. If this is from API, check your JSON syntax.
suggestions.ipadapter_image_encoding_failed: IPAdapter Image Encoding Failed: Failed to encode image with CLIP vision model. Verify image format and model compatibility.
suggestions.ipadapter_incompatible: Incompatible IPAdapter: This IPAdapter is incompatible with the current base model. Ensure correct IPAdapter version (SD1.5/SDXL).
suggestions.ipadapter_model_not_found: IPAdapter Model Not Found: The IPAdapter model file could not be found. Check models/ipadapter/ directory.
suggestions.ipadapter_weight_error: Invalid IPAdapter Weight: IPAdapter weight value is invalid. Typical range is 0.0 to 2.0.
suggestions.key_error: Key Error: Key '{0}' not found. This might be due to incompatible model config or malformed Workflow JSON.
suggestions.lora_corrupted: Corrupted LoRA File: The LoRA file appears to be corrupted or has an invalid format. Try re-downloading the file.
suggestions.lora_incompatible: Incompatible LoRA: This LoRA is incompatible with the current base model architecture. Ensure you're using the correct LoRA for your model (SD1.5/SDXL).
suggestions.lora_key_mismatch: LoRA Key Mismatch: LoRA weight keys don't match the model structure. This LoRA may be for a different model architecture.
suggestions.lora_not_found: LoRA Not Found: The specified LoRA model file could not be found. Check if the file exists in models/loras/ directory.
suggestions.lora_oom: LoRA Out of Memory: Out of memory when loading or applying LoRA. Try reducing batch size or using fewer LoRAs simultaneously.
suggestions.lora_strength_invalid: Invalid LoRA Strength: The LoRA strength value is invalid. Typical range is -2.0 to 2.0, with 1.0 being normal strength.
suggestions.matrix_mult: Matrix Multiplication Error: This usually happens when model architecture doesn't match the weights (e.g., SD1.5 vs SDXL). Check if your Checkpoint matches your LoRA/ControlNet.
suggestions.meta_tensor: Empty Data: Detected a 'Meta Tensor' which contains shape info but no actual data. This usually happens before model execution. If this persists during execution, check upstream nodes.
suggestions.missing_input: Missing Input: Required input '{0}' is not provided. Check if the upstream node output is connected correctly.
suggestions.missing_insightface: Missing InsightFace: IPAdapter or Reactor node requires 'insightface'. Please follow ComfyUI-Manager guide to install the pre-built wheel.
suggestions.missing_module: Missing Dependency: Python module '{0}' is missing. Please run 'pip install {0}' in your ComfyUI python environment.
suggestions.model_vae_mismatch: Model/VAE Mismatch: Detected mismatched configurations (e.g. SDXL VAE with SD1.5 Model). Please replace the VAE or Checkpoint.
suggestions.mps_oom: MPS (Mac) OOM: Out of memory on Mac Metal backend. Try setting 'PYTORCH_MPS_HIGH_WATERMARK_RATIO=0.0' environment variable.
suggestions.oom: OOM (Out Of Memory): Your GPU VRAM is full. Try: 1. Reducing Batch Size. 2. Using '--lowvram' flag. 3. Closing other GPU apps.
suggestions.safetensors_error: SafeTensors Error: Failed to load model. The file might be corrupted (incomplete download). Please delete and re-download the model.
suggestions.sampler_not_found: Sampler Not Found: The specified sampler is not available. Check sampler name or update ComfyUI to the latest version.
suggestions.scheduler_error: Scheduler Configuration Error: The scheduler configuration is invalid. Verify scheduler parameters and compatibility.
suggestions.shape_mismatch: Shape Mismatch: {0}. Please verify input image dimensions match the model's expectations.
suggestions.tensor_nan_inf: Data Anomaly: Detected {0} in the tensor. This often causes black images. Check your model precision (FP16/FP32), VAE config, or CFG scale.
suggestions.torch_oom: PyTorch Out of Memory! This is the newer CUDA OOM error format. Suggestions: 1. Reduce Batch Size 2. Use --lowvram 3. Close other GPU programs.
suggestions.type_mismatch: Type Mismatch: The model expects {0} (e.g., fp16) but received {1} (e.g., float32). Try using a 'Cast Tensor' node or checking your VAE/Model loading precision.
suggestions.vae_batch_size_error: VAE Batch Size Too Large: Batch size is too large for VAE processing. Reduce batch size or use tiled VAE.
suggestions.vae_decode_failed: VAE Decode Failed: VAE latent decode operation failed. Check VAE model compatibility and ensure latent dimensions are correct.
suggestions.vae_encode_failed: VAE Encode Failed: VAE image encode operation failed. Verify input image format and VAE model compatibility.
suggestions.vae_fp16_issue: VAE Precision Issue: VAE has precision issues, likely fp16/fp32 mismatch. Try using --force-fp32 or switch to a fp32 VAE.
suggestions.vae_tiling_error: VAE Tiling Error: VAE tiling configuration is invalid. Adjust the tile size parameters or disable tiling.
suggestions.validation_error: Validation Error in {0}: {1}. Check input connections and ensure node requirements are met.
suggestions.value_not_in_list: Value Not In List: '{0}' is not available in the current dropdown/list. This often happens when importing someone else's workflow. Fix: 1) Install the referenced model/resource (Checkpoint/LoRA/VAE/ControlNet, etc.) with the same filename, or 2) Change the node's selection to an existing local option and save the workflow. If you recently added/renamed models, refresh model lists or restart ComfyUI.
